name: Elowen
summary: Elowen stands on a stainless steel base, refined in form and finished with a choice of sumptuous materials — from matte leather to classic CP leather, rich velvet, or sophisticated faux leather. Each variation offers its own expression of elegance, allowing Elowen to adapt seamlessly to any refined interior. 60x59x80
